analysis.support_validation: Control: pair0 PARTIAL 3/4 (sigma/residual/VR matched, mean 0.0110), pair1 WEAK 2/4 (sigma +62%, VR 9%, reproduced exactly in-session), pair2 WEAK 2/4 (sigma +57%, mean 0.0237), pair3 PARTIAL 3/4 (mean 0.0126), pair4 WEAK 2/4 (sigma +68%, VR -18%). 14 test_candidate.py runs / 7 pipelines: no candidate achieves WEAK->PARTIAL/MATCH improvement on >=4/5 pairs; best alternative (poisson5+sat2) improves only pair2 and regresses pair0/pair3.
analysis.rationale: Compression (block_boundary 0.997-1.004, unique_G=256) and blur (spectral_slope_ratio 0.947-0.986) remain ruled out on all 5 pairs. Noise type remains YCrCb-space: clean channel means are equal (max/min 1.05-1.16) but residual channel-std ratio is 1.54-2.07 with G always lowest, contradicting speckle/poisson/Gaussian_RGB signatures; target chroma std is nearly constant (105-131) while clean chroma varies 9-40, and satYCrCb sev1 (x2, luma-preserving) reproduces pair0/1 chroma. The control's only systematic deviation is noise_prior sigma overshoot on pairs 1/2/4 (+57..+68%), attributed to gamut-clipping compression of the chroma-noise field on colorful/bright content (target clip 0.37-0.47), not to severity error: sev3 leaves sigma +33% and worsens VR, sat2 raises sigma to +84%, order swap collapses VR by ~50%. Positive residual-intensity correlation (ric +0.02..+0.37 vs -0.05 for additive sims) keeps a Poisson component plausible but the Poisson family regresses the aggregate verdicts. R0 pipeline retained.
